name: shortlist-01
title: Shortlist 01 - Capabilities A Reader Is Considering
description: A set of capabilities a reader is considering, drawn as cards or rows with a mark slot, a name, a one line reason, an optional price through the Price component, a move control, a remove control and a slot for the caller own controls over the whole set. The controls are part of the item rather than a row action, because a shortlist is a set the reader chose and can change, and both control names are functions because a remove control announced only as Remove gives a screen reader one identical button per item and leaves the reader guessing which one they are on.
